LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 6.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we be keen when listening to a text? 2. How do we listen for specific information?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording and pick out vocabulary items based on the theme – The Farm,

2. work jointly to create a vocabulary bank on the words picked out from the texts,

3. collaborate with peers to answer comprehension questions based on the text,

4. work jointly to read adverbs aloud from flashcards,

5. collaboratively role play various adverbs from a chart, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording and pick out vocabulary items based on the theme – The Farm,
2. work jointly to create a vocabulary bank on the words picked out from the texts,
3. collaborate with peers to answer comprehension questions based on the text,
4. work jointly to read adverbs aloud from flashcards,
5. collaboratively role play various adverbs from a chart, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to an audio recording and

picking out vocabulary items.

• Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner speaks engagingly using facts and examples when

conducting a simple debate on the theme.

Values:
• Unity: This is developed as the learner collaborates with others to role play various adverbs from a chart.

• Social justice: This is enhanced as the learner participates in the sharing of roles fairly when working jointly to read

adverbs aloud from flash cards.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education is promoted as the learner is exposed to content and concepts on the farm for their day-to-day

experiences.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of the farm to their knowledge of Agriculture.
